meta.scope: Classify S833 heat-probe behavior and morphology evidence separately from neural response

records.title: Low FoxO expression in Drosophila somatosensory neurons protects dendrite growth under nutrient restriction

searches.query: Primary Methods > Behavior assay; Results > Figure 6A-E; distinguish behavior, dendrite morphology, and neural response

validation.notes: Primary eLife full text checked. Heat-probe-evoked complete rolling behavior (Methods > Behavior assay; Results > Figure 6A-E) and C4da dendrite morphology are separate endpoints. Neural response was not measured; no subjective pain measure. Curated as included_core under the automated verified_primary rule; evidence role remains method_baseline and does not establish neural response. DOI 10.7554/eLife.53351; seed S282 v1 JATS c62.
